newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE'S CASTAIGNEDE TO MISS WALES MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE'S CASTAIGNEDE TO MISS WALES MATCH.

text.p: France's Thomas Castaignede will miss the Five Nations' rugby union clash with Wales on February 15 in Paris because of a broken jaw, his club said on Tuesday.
Castaignede, who plays either centre or flyhalf, was injured playing for Toulouse in a French league match on Sunday. He underwent surgery on Tuesday.
A Toulouse spokesman said he would be out of action for "at least 30 days", which means he could also miss France's following match against England at Twickenham on March 1.
He will be replaced in France's 21-man squad for the match against Wales by Bourgoin winger Laurent Leflamand, a French team spokesman said.
